title: LZMA (alone) signature
summary: An LZMA-alone file begins with a 1-byte properties (lc/lp/pb), 4-byte dictionary size, and 8-byte uncompressed size. The magic is the properties byte (0x5D for default settings: lc=3, lp=0, pb=2).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: LZMA uses a range coder + LZ77 with a large dictionary (up to 4GB).
LZMA is the basis of 7z, XZ, and many other formats.
